what: On a dark plate, 56 thin-line cubes (sides 2~7) float scattered within depth 70, and one in three has a word on its front face at .4 opacity (.7 of the face size). While the plate passes the screen (top top → bottom bottom, scrub), the camera advances from z 8 to −58 and turns sideways by 1.2 radians, passing between the cubes.

options.turn: Radians rotated while passing by, default 1.2
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Words to stick on the cube faces (several) — hidden on screen

note: three must be global (window.THREE) to run — load three-global.js before three.cjs. The panel height is the scroll length (300vh by default). The original cube positions and text sizes could not be measured, so they were scattered again at the same density

from.where: index.js cubes — sticky canvas inside .cubes(400vh), nine words
